<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_RelatedPartyTransactionsAbstract', window );"><strong>Related Party Transactions [Abstract]</strong></a></td>

<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Related Party Transactions</a></td>
<td class="text">Related Party Transactions<div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Certain members of the Dolan family, including trusts for the benefit of members of the Dolan family, for purposes of Section 13(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, beneficially owned 100% of MSG Knicks&#8217; outstanding Class B common stock and 3.1% of MSG Knicks&#8217; outstanding Class A common stock.  Such shares of MSG Knicks&#8217; Class A common stock and Class B common stock, collectively, represent approximately 70.7% of the aggregate voting power of MSG Knicks&#8217; outstanding common stock.  Pursuant to the Rangers Distribution on October 26, 2026, MSG Knicks distributed 100% of the outstanding common stock of the Company to its stockholders with one share of the Company&#8217;s Class A common stock issued for every two shares of MSG Knicks Class A common stock held as of the Record Date, and one share of the Company&#8217;s Class B common stock issued for every share of MSG Knicks&#8217; Class B common stock held as of the Record Date.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Members of the Dolan family are also the controlling stockholders of MSG Knicks, Sphere Entertainment Co. (&#8220;Sphere Entertainment&#8221;), MSG Entertainment and AMC Global Media Inc. (&#8220;AMC Global Media&#8221;).</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Related Party Arrangements as of September 30, 2026</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Company was party to the following agreements and/or arrangements with MSG Entertainment as of September&#160;30, 2026:</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Arena License Agreement, pursuant to which MSG Entertainment (i) provides the right to use The Garden for games of the Rangers for a 35-year term ending June 30, 2055 in exchange for arena license fees, (ii) shares revenues collected for suite and club licenses, (iii) operates and manages the sale of Rangers merchandise at The Garden for a commission, (iv) operates and manages the sales of food and beverage concessions in exchange for 50% of net profits from sales and catering services during Rangers home games, (v) shares revenues collected for the sale of venue indoor signage space and sponsorship rights at The Garden that are not specific to the Rangers, (vi) provides day of game services, and (vii) provides other general services within The Garden;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Sponsorship sales and service representation agreement, entered into in April 2020 (the &#8220;Sponsorship Sales and Service Representation Agreement&#8221;), pursuant to which MSG Entertainment has the exclusive right and obligation to sell the Company&#8217;s sponsorships for an initial stated term of 10 years for a commission. In addition, under this </span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">agreement, the Company is charged by MSG Entertainment for sales and service staff and overhead associated with the sales of sponsorship assets; and</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Arrangements pursuant to which the Company provides MSG Entertainment other business operations services.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Company was also party to the following agreements and/or arrangements with Sphere Entertainment (including through its subsidiary MSG Networks) as of </span><span style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">September&#160;30, 2026</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">:</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Local telecast rights agreements between the Company and MSG Networks, as amended in June 2025 and set to expire after the 2028-29 season, providing MSG Networks with local telecast rights for Rangers games in exchange for telecast rights fees;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Agreement related to audio-only distribution rights for Rangers games;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Arrangements with MSG Networks pursuant to which the Rangers have allocated revenues with MSG Networks related to virtual advertising inventory; and</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Arrangements pursuant to which the Company provides Sphere Entertainment with certain business operations services.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In connection with the Rangers Distribution, the Company entered into the following agreements and/or arrangements with MSG Knicks:</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Transition services agreement pursuant to which MSG Knicks provides certain corporate and other services to the Company, including with respect to such areas as information technology, accounts payable, payroll, tax, certain legal functions, human resources, insurance and risk management, government affairs, investor relations, corporate communications, benefit plan administration and reporting, and internal audit functions as well as certain marketing functions, in exchange for service fees, and the Company provides certain services to MSG Knicks in exchange for service fees;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">A lease agreement with MSG Knicks with respect to MSG Knicks&#8217; use of the Madison Square Garden Training Center with a term of 10 years. Pursuant to the lease, MSG Knicks pays the Company an annual fixed rent of $2&#160;million for the first contract year, and then for each subsequent year, the fixed rent will be 103% of the fixed rent for the immediately preceding contract year. The Company also receives a reimbursement from MSG Knicks for certain operating expenses and capital expenditures incurred in connection with the Madison Square Garden Training Center; and</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Group ticket sales representation agreement, pursuant to which the Company is appointed as MSG Knicks&#8217; sales and service representative to sell group ticket packages related to MSG Knicks and MSG Entertainment events in exchange for a commission and reimbursement for sales and service staff and overhead associated with the ticket sales on behalf of MSG Knicks;</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Single night rental commission agreement, pursuant to which the Company may, from time to time, sell (or make referrals for sales of) licenses for the use of suites at The Garden for individual MSG Knicks and MSG Entertainment events in exchange for a commission; and</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Other agreements with MSG Knicks in connection with the Rangers Distribution, including a distribution agreement, a tax disaffiliation agreement and an employee matters agreement and certain other arrangements.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In connection with the Rangers Distribution, the Company entered into the following agreements and/or arrangements with MSG Knicks, MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment and AMC Global Media, as applicable:</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Various arrangements with subsidiaries of MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment and MSG Knicks, pursuant to which the Company has the right to lease on a time-sharing and/or dry lease basis certain aircraft to which MSG Entertainment and MSG Knicks have access, and pursuant to which MSG Entertainment provides certain aircraft support services;</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Arrangements pursuant to which the Company shares certain executive support costs, including office space, executive assistants, security and transportation costs for: (i) the Company&#8217;s Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer with MSG Knicks, Sphere Entertainment and MSG Entertainment, (ii) the Company&#8217;s Vice Chairman with AMC Global Media, MSG Knicks, Sphere Entertainment and MSG Entertainment, and (iii) the Company&#8217;s Executive Vice President with MSG Knicks, Sphere Entertainment and AMC Global Media; and</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">A marketing sponsorship allocation agreement with MSG Knicks, MSG Entertainment and Sphere Entertainment, pursuant to which each party receives an allocation of certain sponsorship and signage revenues associated with sponsorship agreements that include the assets of the Company, MSG Knicks, MSG Entertainment and Sphere Entertainment, as applicable, based on the percentage of revenue each company earns relative to the total contract value.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In connection with the Rangers Distribution, the Company was assigned a portion of warrants exercisable for approximately 6.5% of the equity interests in MSG Networks.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Revenues and Operating Expenses (Credits)</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following table summarizes the composition and amounts of the transactions with the Company&#8217;s affiliates. These amounts are reflected in revenues and operating expenses in the accompanying combined statements of operations and comprehensive loss for the three months ended September&#160;30, 2026 and Allocations from MSG Knicks and Allocations to MSG Knicks</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The accompanying combined statements of operations and comprehensive loss include allocations for certain support functions that are provided on a centralized basis and not historically recorded at the component level by MSG Knicks, such as expenses related to executive management, finance, legal, human resources, government affairs, information technology and facilities-related services, among others. These expenses have been allocated to the Company from MSG Knicks on the basis of direct usage when identifiable, with the remainder allocated on a pro-rata basis of combined revenue, headcount or other measures of the Company or MSG Knicks, which is recorded as in either direct operating expenses or selling, general and administrative (&#8220;SG&amp;A&#8221;) expenses. In addition, costs associated with the company&#8217;s training center were allocated to MSG Knicks from the Company on a pro-rata basis as a reduction of either direct operating expenses or SG&amp;A expenses.</span></div><span></span>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for related party transactions. Examples of related party transactions include transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiary; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) and entity and its principal owners; and (d) affiliates.</p></div>
